column9: Standalone float AVG state is deleted and retained as a test-only specialization beside the live canonical AVG fold.
Standalone exact integer DISTINCT state is deleted and retained as a test-only specialized merge boundary; live dispatch uses the prerequisite tuple-key authority.
COUNT partial state now has one authority directly consumed by aggregate and window folding.
Count-only spill helper is deleted in favor of one shared test-only aggregate spill boundary; no live Database/window spill owner is claimed.
Standalone float SUM is deleted; typed merge/slide remain test-only beside the live canonical SQL SUM fold.
Standalone integer SUM is deleted and retained for the separate SUM_INT checked domain and its test-only sliding boundary; ordinary SQL SUM promotes integers to Decimal.
Partial AVG merge remains explicit under the consolidated owner.
AVG value behavior remains explicit under the consolidated owner.
AVG state-size evidence moves while allocator parity remains partial.
Distinct COUNT reset/cardinality evidence moves while allocator parity remains partial; the unrelated parallel-distinct test remains in the retained old-owner evidence file.

SUM reset/state evidence moves while allocator parity remains partial.
